FAQ - Vinyl Liner Replacement & Installation

Pool Liner Replacement & Installation Frequently Asked Questions

We’re excited to provide answers to the most common questions pool owners in Cambridge, ON have about replacing and installing vinyl liners.

How Much Does It Cost To Replace A Pool Liner In Cambridge?

Replacing a pool liners typically costs between $5000-$12,000 + HST with the average cost being between $5500 and $8000.

The most common factors that affect the price include.

  • Pool Size, Shape, & Depth
  • Refilling the pool water by tap or having water trucked in
  • Liner pattern selection
  • Built in vinyl over steel features such as steps & benches
  • Extra repairs to the pools bottom, walls, coping, or other pool repairs
How Long Does It Take To Replace A Pool Liner

Most pool liners can be replaced in 1-day if the replacement water is trucked in. If you wish to fill your pool with a garden hose it can take up to a week to complete.
Are There Extra Costs When Replacing A Pool Liner?

You could face some additional hidden costs when replacing a pool liner.

These costs often can't be determined until the old liner is removed.

Examples of hidden costs include

  • Structural repairs to corroded or rusted wall panels
  • Repairs to damaged concrete/vermiculite on the pool floor
  • Making main drains VGB compliant or removing them altogether
  • Replacing corroded or damaged skimmers and returns 
What thickness Liner Does Hipel Pools Install Our standard liners are 27 Mil but we can offer upgrades to 30Mil or 32 Mil liners if required for an additional fee.
